item.title: Warm end to the weekend, valley snow likely next week
item.description: Happy Sunday, Utah! Expect another warm afternoon in store with an increase in cloud cover and breezy southerly winds.

item.title: 1 ejected from vehicle, killed in Salt Lake City rollover crash
item.description: A driver is dead after being ejected from their vehicle in a rollover crash in Salt Lake City Sunday morning, according to Salt Lake City Police.

item.title: 1 seriously injured in Salt Lake City apartment fire
item.description: One person was seriously injured in an apartment fire in Salt Lake City early Sunday morning, according to Salt Lake City Fire.

item.title: ABC4 on Samsung TV: How to get News4Utah+ app on your TV
item.description: You can now stream ABC4’s newscasts with the latest breaking news, get your 4Warn weather forecast, watch original shows, sports programming, and more- all for FREE! You can download the News4Utah+ app on any Samsung TV model from 2023 or later.

item.title: Vehicle crashes into power pole in Millcreek, road closure in place
item.description: Road closures are in place due to a traffic accident at 3300 S. and 2400 East in Millcreek.

item.title: 2 arrested after more than 11 pounds of meth found during Grand County traffic stop
item.description: Two people were arrested after more than 11 pounds of meth were discovered in a vehicle during a traffic stop in Grand County.

item.title: $26 million entertainment destination opens near UT-WY border
item.description: After a successful ribbon-cutting ceremony on Feb. 14, the Utah-Wyoming border is officially home to Horse Palace Gateway, a new entertainment destination off of Interstate-80.

item.title: Utah GOP chair 'very confident' signature thresholds met to put Prop 4 repeal on Nov. ballot
item.description: As the 5:00 p.m. deadline passed on Feb 15, the chair of Utah's Republican Party says he's "very confident" that the effort to repeal Proposition 4 has enough signatures in enough Senate districts to be on November's ballot.

item.title: 'The history books will write about this day': Next generation nuclear reactor arrives at Hill Air Force Base aboard a C17
item.description: Today, Utah took another major step on its mission to lead the United States in nuclear energy. A new advanced nuclear reactor landed at Hill Air Force Base, welcomed by local and federal leaders.

item.title: WATCH: Small plane makes emergency landing on Legacy Parkway
item.description: A small plane made an emergency landing on Legacy Parkway in Woods Cross on Sunday evening.
